description: This file defines a Java interface 'TaxRateDao' that extends a generic DAO interface, providing method signatures for accessing tax rate data related to tax rates, stores, countries, zones, tax classes, and languages within a sales management system.

classes.name: TaxRateDao
classes.description: Java interface for data access operations related to TaxRate entities, providing method signatures for querying tax rates based on store, country, zone, tax class, and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Returns tax rates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Returns tax rates filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate by its unique code within the context of a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Overloaded method that returns tax rates for a store tailored to a specific language.
